_readme: One sponsor slot at the top of every sponsorable page on milecheckapp.com: the home page and mile-marker map (home:), state and metro camera pages (cameras:), interstate corridors (corridor:), mountain passes (pass:), drawbridge pages (bridge:), state and province mile-marker guides (guide:), highway-basics explainers (basics:), blog posts and reports (article:), and the live-conditions pages (live:).

Sponsorships are sold by TOPIC, one sponsor per topic (Leah, 2026-09-24: not by state or location). The config still carries one entry per page, keyed <family>:<slug>; a topic sale is one entry per page in that family. Keys of any other shape are refused by the generator.
Pricing is not public. The house slot and /sponsor/ send people to sales@milecheckapp.com. There is no online checkout (dropped 2026-09-24).
Dates are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD in UTC. A slot outside its dates is skipped and the house slot renders. Pages are static, so a date change takes effect when the pages are regenerated.

Fields: id (letters, digits, dashes; this is what the report groups by), name, copy (one sentence, under 90 characters), url (the sponsor's landing page, with their UTM if they want one), cta (2-4 words), logo (path under /images/sponsors/, PNG or SVG, transparent background, at least 2x for a 36px-tall display), logoW and logoH (the file's pixel size, so the browser reserves the box), start, end.

After any change, from the site root: node scripts/gen-corridor-pages.js && node scripts/gen-state-camera-pages.js && node scripts/gen-city-camera-pages.js && node scripts/gen-pass-pages.js && node scripts/add-sponsor-slots.mjs && node scripts/tag-store-links.mjs --pt 128447811 && node scripts/add-analytics.mjs G-CDMSB5630W, then commit and push. add-sponsor-slots.mjs also rewrites data/sponsor-pages.json, which /sponsor/ and /sponsor/pages/ read.

Preview for sales: any page + ?sponsor=preview (optionally &name=&copy=&cta=) shows a sample sponsor in the slot and counts nothing. /sponsor/pages/ lists every page with its numbers and a preview link.
Counting and the report: docs/website-sponsor-slot.md in the app repo.
